newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-GRIQUAS WIN TOSS, BAT AGAINST INDIA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-GRIQUAS WIN TOSS, BAT AGAINST INDIA.

text.p: Griqualand West won the toss and chose to bat in the one-day match against India at Kimberley Country Club on Thursday.
Griqualand West - Mickey Arthur (captain), Martyn Gidley, Pieter Barnard, Willie Dry, Ralph Koster, Craig Light, Cedric English, Brett Benkenstein, Wendel Bossenger, Adri Swanepoel, Garth Roe.
India - Saurav Ganguly, Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Rahul Dravid, Mohammad Azharuddin, V.V.S. Laxman, Pankaj Dharmani, Saba Karim, Anil Kumble, Dodda Ganesh, David Johnson, Venkatapathy Raju.
